propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks a CI lock mechanism, allowing any contributor to modify it without administrator review, unlike module-size-limit.txt which is locked against main
The baseline can grow silently by adding new entries above the C901 threshold with matching baseline entries, since the test suite validates count matching but not monotonic entry count decrease
CI must enforce a semantic shrink-only ratchet on complexity-baseline.json: rejecting raised ceilings and new entries while permitting removed entries and lowered ceilings
The module-size limit's fail-open behavior (warning + continue on failed git fetch) allows unverified cap changes; both locks must fail closed instead
A legitimate baseline entry removal from a refactored function should pass without override, while adding a new high-complexity function with its baseline entry should fail CI
